description: The InfraPPP project tracker is a commercial database of public-private partnership and other infrastructure projects worldwide, updated daily from project finance news. Projects can be filtered by region and country, by sector (roads, railways, ports, power transmission, renewables, solar, wind, water, wastewater, waste, telecom, hospitals, schools, prisons, street lighting and more), by investment band from US$1 million to over US$501 million, by dates of financial close, contract award, refinancing or completion, and by stage from planning, tender and award through construction to operation, cancellation or hold. InfraPPP, a specialist news and data service, runs it alongside databases of transactions, funds and companies. Coverage is global. Format and access: a web database with Excel export; listings are visible but project content and exports need a paid subscription. Licence: commercial terms; paid. Caveats: coverage depends on news reporting and stage data can lag, and the content could not be checked without a subscription. It supports capacity planning and pipeline scenarios for future infrastructure. A related catalogue record is the World Bank Private Participation in Infrastructure database, a free alternative for developing countries.
